name: Basic Arduino Sketch
description: A sketch that blinks the board's own light, on for half a second and off for half a second. It compiles as it is.
_entry_point_note: arduino-cli requires a sketch folder whose name matches its .ino file, so the entry point carries the subdirectory. Measured in SPIKES.md section 14; the flat layout fails with 'main file missing from sketch: src/src.ino'.
